text:
maria: Heads up — noticed ~120 invoices from the midnight batch where usage credit stublines didn't make it into NetSuite. Stripe shows credits but no credit memos in NS.

sam: which batch window? yesterday 00:00-01:00?

maria: yes, midnight daily job. saw this pattern: when usage rows had inline description > 120 chars, the sync trimmed the stubline_id field and NS mapping failed.

sam: can you paste logs?

maria: ```
INFO 2025-02-10T00:03:12Z batch-runner: processed 3456 usage rows
WARN 2025-02-10T00:03:14Z sync: stripe_charge_id=ch_abc123 missing stubline_id in payload after truncation
ERROR 2025-02-10T00:03:15Z netsuite_uploader: mapping error: missing external_id -> skip
```

billing-bot: Webhook delivered: invoice.payment_succeeded ch_abc123 -> /hooks/finance 200 OK

julian: hmm the DLQ replay truncation bug from the serializer v2.1? we changed payload max_len to 128 for 'desc' last month. if the stubline_id is appended to desc it could be cut off.

maria: yes, looks like the stubline was appended to description in legacy writer. new serializer strips trailing metadata, but DLQ replay used the old writer for some jobs.

finance-ops: are affected customers in any pricing experiment? could be different desc formats.

maria: quick check: ~80% are on default pricing, 20% in trials — not correlated.

eric: can we backfill? easiest is to reprocess the DLQ items and ensure the serializer uses canonical stubline field instead of embedding in desc. also need a small NetSuite import script to create missing credit memos.

sam: agree. risks: duplicate credits if webhook retries already created them. need idempotency key (stripe_charge_id).

maria: plan:
1) pause nightly batch for 1 run
2) reprocess DLQ with fixed serializer (PR #987)
3) run netsuite backfill with idempotency by stripe_charge_id
4) monitor invoices and chase any mismatches

julian: lgtm. who can own the NetSuite backfill script?

maria: I can cobble it, but need finance approval to run backfill against prod NS.

finance-ops: approve to run backfill during maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC. include audit log and dry-run first.

maria: noted. will run dry-run and post results here. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Scheduled job "nightly-batch" paused by ops at 2025-02-10T01:12:05Z

sam: when dry-run done, paste command and sample output (up to 10 rows).

maria: will do. tagging @eric for netsuite creds and @julian for PR review.

eric: I will provision a restricted role for the backfill and rotate creds after.

julian: pushed PR review comments, ready to merge after tests.

maria: DRY RUN finished — 118 candidates, 0 actual writes in dry-run. posting snippet next.

maria: ```
DRY RUN: stripe_charge_id,ch_amount,action
ch_001,120.00,create_credit_memo_candidate
ch_002,15.50,create_credit_memo_candidate
ch_003,9.99,create_credit_memo_candidate
...
```

maria: next steps: merge PR, run a controlled DLQ reprocess against staging, then do prod during approved window. will post timeline and command output. :eyes:
